physics.purpose: Aungier (2003) cascade, leakage and end-wall models on the SLC solver; pending validation.

assumptions: angles, chord and t/c mapped from the element cones to the axial-tangential plane with the printed cone angles
edge planes at the mid-span element's ZI and ZO
uniform inlet total state; inlet end-wall blockage from the measured inlet profile (inlet_blockage)
tip clearance 0.50 mm (TM X-3083 nominal cold clearance 0.05 cm)
stations 1 and 3 at -2.408 and 22.235 cm (not given; the stage 53 survey planes (TP-1299) relative to the stator)
data at the 2-chord stator position: the printed 4-chord stator moved upstream by half its mid-span gap to the rotor (the 2-chord position is not tabulated)
